references.text: Here the laws are described concerning the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution that the priest and his family shall receive from the Israelites' peace offerings, which form the basis for what is mentioned in Lev 10:14.
Refers to the contribution offering (terumah) as part of the sacrificial gifts belonging to the priest.
Describes the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution from the ordination offering, which establishes this practice for the priests.
Confirms that the wave offerings belong to the priest and his sons and daughters as a perpetual right.
Refers to the meat from the sacrifices belonging to Aaron and his children, including the breast of the wave offering and the right thigh.
Defines who in the priest's household may eat from the holy gifts, including his daughters under certain conditions.
Confirms the priests' right to receive the shoulder, the cheeks, and the stomach from the people's slaughter offerings.
